author: Animalogic
description:
Your innocent pet goldfish has a secret. If it ever were to go wild, it would turn into a giant predator that could destroy North America's lakes. But how does an adorable shiny beacon of cuteness become such a feared invasive species? And what it's being done to stop the goldfish already wreaking havoc in our lakes? This is the battle against the megalodon Goldfish.

00:00 Monstrous Goldfish Are Taking Over
00:49 Size Limits & Feral "Megalodons"
02:37 Nicole Turner on Lake Ontario Giants
03:14 Why Do Wild Goldfish Get So Large?
03:55 Domestication History & Selective Breeding
05:34 What Happens When Goldfish Go Feral?
07:27 The Fishway Barrier at Cootes Paradise
08:34 Natural Predators & Rapid Breeding
10:11 Extreme Survival Adaptations (Torpor & Alcohol)
11:59 Environmental Destruction & "Suck-Spit" Feeding
14:49 How Goldfish Invade & Modern Eradication Methods

18:25 Researching Asexual Reproduction (Clones)
20:09 Community Involvem
title: Why Goldfish Get So Big In The Wild
